text:
Stop picking your AI model by hype.

Every launch says frontier. Every headline says biggest. None of that tells you which one to actually open for the job in front of you.

Here's the filter our hosts use on Tech Thursday, half-joking but dead serious: one model feels like Harvard. One feels like it's for the people. Neither is wrong -- they're built for different work.

Ask three questions before you open a tab: What's the actual job -- deep reasoning or a fast answer? What's the real budget for this task, not your subscription tier? What tone do you actually want back -- dense and thorough, or straight to the point?

Then test the same prompt on two models and compare. The gap tells you more than any leaderboard.

The skill isn't loyalty to one brand. It's knowing which one to reach for.

Save this framework.
